The token arithmetic below is the script's own hand-audit formula from its header (`ceil((wc -c − stamp line) / 4)`, every other file `ceil(wc -c / 4)`) applied to the blobs — not a run of the gate; CI's `Type Check · source gates` is the gate verdict. Base: the PR's merge-base with `main` is 75afeffd (one commit, +40/−5 over 3 files, identical whether diffed against 75afeffd or against the `origin/main` tip 26e7c75e — the extra ConsoleToaster paths in a tip diff are main's #26426, not this PR's).

### ① Derived judgments

**(a) Every new sentence is true of the spec and the engine on `origin/main`.** The rewritten `screen` row (SKILL.md L91, the only teaching hunk; lines 1–90 and 92–207 are byte-identical to the base):
- `'record_link'` (never `'record'`, an object field type) — RIGHT: `SCREEN_FIELD_RECORD_LINK_TYPE = 'record_link'` with the doc comment giving exactly that reason (`FieldType` already spells `'record'` for embedded sub-objects), builtin-node-config.zod.ts L810–816; the test's first case pins the spelling.
- "takes no input — it shows the `reference` record whose id `defaultValue` evaluates to, by display name, as a link to its record page" — RIGHT, near-verbatim from the `type` `.describe()` text at L973–977 and the doc comment at L964–971 (display name = ADR-0079 `nameField`).
- "the result screen of a flow that created records" — RIGHT: the doc comment's last sentence, and the engine's resume test (`convertFlow`: two `create_record` nodes, then the screen).
- the example `{ name: 'account_link', type: 'record_link', reference: 'crm_account', defaultValue: { dialect: 'cel', source: 'account.id' } }` over a `create_record` `outputVariable: 'account'` — RIGHT and the spelling the resume actually resolves: screen-record-link-resume.test.ts declares `outputVariable: 'account'` and `defaultValue: CEL('account.id')`, and asserts the paused screen serves `defaultValue: 'crm_account_1'`; the dogfood fixture uses the same shape. (The spec's own refusal text example is `source: 'account_id'`, a bare flow variable — also legal, a different flow shape; the row's choice matches the card's and the engine test's.)
- "Both keys required" (`reference`, `defaultValue`) — RIGHT: the `superRefine` branch at L1079–1092 adds `SCREEN_FIELD_RECORD_LINK_REFERENCE_REQUIRED` for a missing/blank `reference` and `…_DEFAULT_VALUE_REQUIRED` for `undefined`/`null` `defaultValue`; both pinned in the spec test.
- "`required` / `options` / `placeholder` / `min` / `max` refused" — RIGHT: `SCREEN_FIELD_RECORD_LINK_REFUSED_KEYS` is exactly that five-tuple (L844, pinned by `toEqual` in the test), each refused at its own key (`required: false` included, since the key itself is the error).
- "a resume value under its name refused (`400 INVALID_SCREEN_INPUT`)" — RIGHT: `validateScreenInputs` refuses ANY value under a `record_link` field's name, `null` and hidden included, with `invalid_value` (screen-input-contract.ts L173–184 and the record-link-field test); the engine answers code `INVALID_SCREEN_INPUT` (resume test, refusal keeps the pause and binds nothing); the dogfood test asserts HTTP status 400 with that code (flow-screen-record-link.dogfood.test.ts L110–115). The row does not teach `judgeHeadlessScreen` (a caller param never counts a link as answered) — not owed by the card, not a gap an author needs.
- "A completed `end` `message` is refused" — RIGHT: `EndConfigSchema` (L1351, L1413: "`message` is only rendered when `outcome` is 'refused' — on a completed end nothing shows it, so the key …" is refused).
- "a markdown link in a screen `description` renders literally" — RIGHT: FlowRunner.tsx L662 renders `shown.description` as a plain text child of `DialogDescription`; no markdown pass anywhere in the file.
- `lookup` contrast: the row (and the whole SKILL.md) never teaches `lookup`, so no contrast clause was owed; none drawn.

**(b) The one cut is a genuine duplicate with a surviving home.** Filter operands bullet, L209–210: "every other `{…}` token is refused (`expression-invalid`) with its envelope" → "every other `{…}` token is refused". Surviving home, same file, Valid-but-silently-wrong item 1 (head L228–236): "… every CRUD `filter` operand, a string is the literal text it spells, and a `{…}` token is **refused** — at `objectstack validate` (`expression-invalid`), `registerFlow` and the executor — naming its CEL spelling. Compute with `{ dialect: 'cel', source: '…' }`". Item 1 names the filter operand surface explicitly, the error id `expression-invalid`, the two further refusal sites, and the CEL envelope the refusal names — every clause of the cut survives and the home says MORE than the cut did. The surviving filter bullet still carries what is specific to it (the whole-string query-placeholder pass-through, the no-shadowing rule, "only `filter` gets this hand-off"). No rule lost. Cosmetic only: the cut left L210 short ("never shadows a placeholder. Only") — a re-wrap would have bought no tokens and was rightly not done.

**(c) Ratchet rows pinned at the measurement; ruling A applied and quoted.** Hand audit on the blobs: SKILL.md head 24674 bytes, stamp line L16 `  version: "18.1.0"` 20 bytes → priced 24654 → ceil(24654/4) = **6164** = the row (headroom 2 bytes, 0 tokens); base 24034 − 20 = 24014 → 6004 = main's row (headroom 2 bytes, 0 tokens) — the file was at zero headroom, so ruling A applies. Per-hunk bytes: L91 399 → 1080 (+681), the filter bullet 230 → 189 (−41), net +640 = 24674 − 24034 — the row comment's and the body's arithmetic (+681/−41/+640, 24014 → 24654) is exact. Eval file 7289 → 8561 bytes (+1272) → ceil(8561/4) = **2141** = the row (base 1823, headroom 3 bytes, 0 tokens). Neither row is above its measurement (no smuggled headroom), neither below (no red gate). The tap 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 is quoted verbatim and untranslated in both row comments and in the PR body (What changes item 4 and 维护者速读); the script's header requires the ruling in "a PR whose body quotes a maintainer ruling" — met. Sibling rows: `git diff origin/main c9e57c28 -- scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` touches ONLY the two objectstack-automation rows and their comments; every other row on the head equals `origin/main` NOW, so nothing is stale against #26420 or any later sibling. The new comment blocks sit inside the `CEILINGS` map like every other row comment (the remedy-authority anchor is the SHRINK-ONLY doc comment above the map, untouched). Lane: `Lint · ESLint` success on the head (long comment lines are not capped); `Type Check · source gates` (job `typecheck-source-gates`, lint.yml L5419–5420: ratchet self-test + ratchet; L5156 `check:skill-docs`; L5288 `check:skill-refs`) success at 2026-10-27T04:07Z.

**(d) Eval 9.** The file parses; ids 1–9 unique and sequential; entry 9 has the same key set as entry 8 (`id`, `prompt`, `expected_output`, `files`, `assertions`). The prompt is byte-for-byte the card's. All five `must_contain` strings occur in the expected output; neither `must_not_contain` string (`type: 'record'`, `](`) occurs in the prompt or the expected output — `type: 'record_link'` does not contain `type: 'record'` (the quote closes after `_link`), and the ideal answer says "never the object field type" instead of spelling the negation. The expected output is consistent with the row: screen flow, two `create_record` nodes with `outputVariable`, the contact's `fields` linking via a CEL envelope (a legal value slot per item 1 and the engine test's audit node), a last screen of two `record_link` fields with `reference` and `defaultValue` envelopes, no `required`/`placeholder`/`options`, no completed-`end` `message`, no markdown link. The literal `](` is a plain JSON string. No README enumerates this package's evals (`skills/objectstack-automation/evals/README.md` does not exist on the head; only objectstack-data and objectstack-ui have one), so nothing was owed there — the dev's "if it enumerates" observation is moot.

**(e) Card Wanted met, nothing beyond.** Teach: shape ✓, two required keys ✓, five refused keys ✓, resume refusal ✓, `record_link` not `record` ✓, one example ✓. The two "workaround" clauses are inside the card's scope (its Reach paragraph names them and its eval asserts both), not an extension. Eval entry ✓. One home (the row), no `references/examples-flows.md` fragment ✓. `references/_index.md`, `examples-flows.md`, `state-machines-and-approvals.md` byte-identical to the base ✓. Line 1 and the stamp line of SKILL.md untouched ✓. File list = exactly the three files of the claim surface ✓. The teaching is one table cell, no new `os:check` block — the small-feature-written-small default holds (441 → 441 lines).

**(f) PR body.** Line 1 the harness attribution HTML comment, line 2 the harness `_Requested by_` line, line 3 `Fixes #26347`, then `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` line-initial; `clause2-line.mjs` reads both keys per line (`CLAUSE2_KEY_LINE`, `METADATA_PROTOCOL_KEY_LINE`, not anchored to line 1), and the closing-keyword check-runs (`The card this PR closes must claim this branch`, `Part-of PR must not also close its card`, `No other open PR may claim the same issue`) all succeeded. os-dev.md L323 exempts the harness-written first-line attribution comment with `Fixes` "紧随其后"; the harness now writes two lines, so `Fixes` is line 3 — reported by the dev as deviation 1; the parsers do not care (precision note for the seat, below). No `Skills-docs:` line owed (`Metadata-protocol: none`, os-dev.md L279) and none written ✓. 维护者速读: the six labels in the required order; 先看 = 3 files naming the risky hunk; 两分钟验证 = one command with the expected sight, and the sight matches the script's print format exactly (`X is N tokens (ceiling N; headroom 0).` L1066; `authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings` L1154); 需要你做的 = one action (approve / Merge when ready, as the order allowed for Tier H). English sections What changes / Why / Tests / Acceptance notes / Verification with readings in details blocks. Two readings: SKILL.md 441 → 441 ✓ (recomputed); eval 85 → 95 ✓; package = SKILL.md 441 + `_index.md` 46 + `examples-flows.md` 134 + `state-machines-and-approvals.md` 380 = 1001 → 1001 ✓; tokens 6004 + 919 + 1421 + 5587 = 13931 → 6164 + 919 + 1421 + 5587 = 14091 ✓. No model name in the commit, body or report ✓.

**(g) Report shape and claim.** os-dev-report 6433471282 (2026-10-27T04:05Z) carries every key of the os-dev.md template on the head plus `deviations` (5), `line_budget` and `body_amendments` as the dispatch order required; the template on the head lists neither `files_changed` nor `rules_retired`, so none is owed. Branch `claude/project-thread-opn3zo` = the claim's `Branch:` line (6433203119) = the PR head ref ✓. `mcp_calls: 0`, `api_writes: 2` (relay pr_create, report comment) — consistent with the PR object (assignee os-warren, label skip-changeset written at pr_create) and no other write visible on the PR (0 reviews, 0 comments at my read).

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right: `skills/objectstack-automation` has no `package.json` on the head (`git ls-tree`), `scripts/**` publishes nothing; the diff touches no `packages/**`. `Check Changeset` success. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` line-initial ✓.

- Precision (not a card, a 收班简报 note): os-dev.md L323 words the harness exemption as a one-line attribution comment with `Fixes` immediately after; the harness writes two lines (comment + `_Requested by_`), so every PR of this wave has `Fixes` on line 3. Dedupe words: "harness attribution two lines Requested-by Fixes line 3".

Nothing to change in this PR.
- Base reconciliation: PR `base.sha` 26e7c75e = the `origin/main` tip; merge-base 75afeffd; `mergeable: true`, `mergeable_state: blocked` (draft, Tier H approval pending).
- Check-runs on c9e57c28, read at 2026-10-27T04:11Z: 45 runs — 28 success, 16 skipped, 1 in progress (`Test Core (1/8)`); none failed. Gate lanes this PR turns on: `Type Check · source gates` success (ratchet + self-test, `check:skill-docs`, `check:skill-refs`), `Type Check · consumer gates` success (`check:skill-examples`), `Lint · ESLint`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`, all scoped lint lanes success; `Build Core` success (ci.yml job `build-core` hosts `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, the dev's one NOT-MEASURED family); `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size`, `Dogfood Regression Gate` success.
